notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
easyPrerequisites: Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient due to Brad Boimler.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token plus an additional creature token due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
